high_level_description: This image depicts a tall, white monument with a classical architectural design, set against a clear blue sky. The structure is composed of multiple cylindrical sections, each decreasing in size as they ascend. At the top of the monument, there is a golden sculpture featuring four lions standing back-to-back, which is a symbol often associated with India. Below the lions, there is an emblem that includes a wheel and other intricate designs. The monument is flanked by two large columns on either side, which support the upper sections of the structure.
